In 2020, about 3.8M college students experienced food insecurity.

Students should not have to worry about when they will get their next meal. This is why I have introduced the Closing the College Hunger Gap Act to ensure students get the nutrition they need.

This #HungerActionMonth, I’m leading legislation to automatically expand the National School Lunch Program to children enrolled in Medicaid & SSI. This commonsense solution will connect more hungry kids to the nutrition they need to achieve.
